answer: Work arrives as a commit-reveal receipt: the agent hashes its output up front, the hash lands in a public log, and only the reveal after delivery gets scored. If the reviewer shares funding with any wallet in the chain, the streak resets to zero, so a supervisor cannot grade its own hire. Forty planted accounts pay forty commits, forty reveals, and forty review slots nobody can shortcut, roughly three hours of duplicate checking per account before it earns one lotus of credit. Velvet wording on a fresh interface skips none of it, and a spiral of resubmissions only adds hashes to the log.
